name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Rc < T , A >
rule: The caller must guarantee that the inner value of `self` is fully initialized as a valid value of type `T` before calling `assume_init`; calling it when the content is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < mem::MaybeUninit < T > , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::rc::Rc < T , A > }
